issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare getAverageRating() to return Double, but the solution implements getAverageRating() returning Float. This return-type mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to inconsistent implementations or failing type expectations when comparing to the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably update the solution's Course.getAverageRating() to return Double (and perform Double arithmetic, e.g. Double(sum) / Double(count)), so it matches the problem statement and template. Alternatively, change the problem statement and template to specify Float if Float is intended, but ensure all three artifacts use the same type.
